class.name: SoundFontResource
class.brief_description: Imported SoundFont 2 file (`.sf2`), raw bytes of the font.
class.description: Produced by importing a SoundFont 2 file in the editor. The raw file bytes are stored in [member data] and parsed at playback time by the TinySoundFont synthesizer inside [MidiStream].
